class ThrowsAfterAssignment {
  value;
  constructor() { this.value = 1; throw 0; }
}
class ThrowsInFinally {
  value;
  constructor() {
    try { throw 0; }
    finally { this.value = 'set'; throw 1; }
  }
}
class ReplacesReturn {
  value;
  constructor() {
    try { this.value = 1; return; }
    finally { throw 2; }
  }
}
class NestedFinalizers {
  value;
  constructor() {
    try { throw 0; }
    finally {
      try { this.value = 1; return; }
      finally { throw 2; }
    }
  }
}
class ThrowsBeforeAnyAssignment {
  value;
  constructor() { throw 0; }
}
class LoopsForever {
  value;
  constructor() { for (;;) {} }
}
function reads(
  first: ThrowsAfterAssignment, second: ThrowsInFinally, third: ReplacesReturn,
  nested: NestedFinalizers, missing: ThrowsBeforeAnyAssignment, loop: LoopsForever,
): number {
  return first.value.anything() + second.value.anything() + third.value.anything()
    + nested.value.anything() + missing.value.anything() + loop.value.anything();
}
class NormalExit {
  value;
  constructor(flag: boolean) {
    if (flag) { this.value = 'assigned before throwing'; throw 0; }
    this.value = 'returned';
  }
}
console.log(new NormalExit(false).value.toUpperCase());
